types.slide: slide       a new slide replaces the previous one
types.transition: transition  an animated change between slide states
types.reveal: reveal      an increment appears on the existing slide (build step, bullet, overlay)
types.pointing:
pointing    the cursor, laser or highlight comes to rest on, dwells on, or traces a
              specific on-slide element
types.ink: ink         handwritten annotation is drawn on the slide
types.figure: figure      a diagram, image or illustration first appears
types.chart: chart       a plot or graph first appears
types.code: code        a code block first appears
types.animation: animation   embedded animated content plays (video, 3D model, simulation)
types.other: other       a change on the slide surface fitting none of the above
types.reject: reject      not a change on the slide surface, or an artifact

pointing_note:
Classify `pointing` only where the cursor comes to rest, dwells, or traces. Cursor transit
across the screen is not pointing.
reject_note:
Reject: webcam-thumbnail movement, slide numbers, footers,
template chrome, compression artifacts, and returns to a slide already shown with no new
content (mark those `slide` with revisit=true).
